messages.author: 9db0a98eb9074432
messages.subject: getAssociationWithTSS for exons, intron, etc
parts:
Hello,

I'm wondering if there is a similar function to "getAssociationWithTSS" but for exons and introns. For instance, if a DMR is in the gene body of a gene it is possible for it to be closer to a downstream TSS than to the TSS for the gene it resides within. Right now, I am summarizing DMRs with a distance to the nearest TSS using the getAssociationWithTSS and I was contemplating adding a "distance to nearest exon" column. Any input is appreciated.

Thank you,

Brett

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] getAssociationWithTSS for exons, intron, etc
parts:
You can do this using GenomicRanges functions, that what we are using in the background. But there is no function in methylKit to achieve exactly that

Best
Altuna
